description: Manage layout, appearance, security, memory review, and Orion voice preferences for this company workspace.
rolesDescription: Control which B.O.S. areas each employee, manager, subcontractor, or customer can access. Sensitive financial information is protected at both the interface and database layers.
billingDescription: Review your B.O.S. plan, company seats, Orion capacity, invoices, payment method, and renewal settings.
layoutDescription: Choose how B.O.S. is physically arranged. Layout is independent from theme, so either layout can be combined with any B.O.S. color experience.
workspaceLayoutDescription: Switch instantly between the original sidebar workspace and the full-width Top Command workspace. Your choice is saved on this device.
themeDescription: Choose the visual language independently from your layout. Themes control color, surfaces, borders, glow, depth, and atmosphere without changing your B.O.S. data.
themesExperiencesDescription: Select a preview to apply it instantly across B.O.S.
orionVoiceDescription: Configure spoken responses, preferred voice, and speech tuning.
